optional_context_discovery: Use native discovery to find the smallest related Skill, Agent, bounded codebase, governed knowledge source, official research source, or human review needed for the named quality gap.

skills.name: lattice-governor
skills.changes: public capability packages and standards
secondary_audience: Skill authors and maintainers
skills.trigger: public Skill or standard changes
minimum: public repository target and governance goal

skills.name: delivery-verdict-author
skills.changes: bounded evidence into a user-usability verdict
secondary_audience: delivery owners and reviewers
skills.trigger: delivery evidence becomes available
minimum: case, acceptance criteria, and bounded evidence

skills.name: feature-spec-author
skills.changes: an approved requirement into a bounded feature specification
secondary_audience: product owners, developers, and task planners
skills.trigger: a new approved feature request arrives
minimum: requirement, user goal, and constraints
outputs: feature specification and initial case draft

skills.name: powerbi-semantic-accelerator
skills.changes: governed metrics into semantic-model artifacts
secondary_audience: analytics developers, data owners, and report authors
skills.trigger: a semantic model or measure set is requested
minimum: metric definitions, source contracts, and model constraints

skills.name: skill-token-refactor
skills.changes: a verbose Skill package into a behavior-preserving compact package
secondary_audience: Skill maintainers and reviewers
skills.trigger: Skill quality or token budget regresses
minimum: target Skill, baseline behavior, and validator output

skills.name: task-packet-builder
skills.changes: an approved feature definition into an executable task packet
secondary_audience: coding agents, reviewers, and delivery owners
skills.trigger: a feature becomes ready for implementation
minimum: approved case, acceptance criteria, and repository constraints

skills.name: token-economics-dossier-generator
skills.changes: DeliveryYield records into a feature-level economics dossier
secondary_audience: engineering managers and capability strategists
skills.trigger: feature-level token evidence becomes available
minimum: validated yield records and delivery status

skills.name: vscode-workspace-ai-context
skills.changes: a VS Code AI setup into a native-first governed workspace
secondary_audience: developers, maintainers, and security reviewers
skills.trigger: workspace AI configuration changes
minimum: VS Code version, settings, and customizations
outputs: AI configuration audit and bounded patch

skills.name: excalidraw-local-canvas
skills.changes: a visual request into a local-first Excalidraw artifact
secondary_audience: presenters, reviewers, and documentation authors
skills.trigger: an editable canvas is requested
minimum: visual objective, audience, and local output location

skills.name: team-knowledge-plane-governor
skills.changes: scattered team knowledge into governed contracts
secondary_audience: knowledge owners, security reviewers, and retrieval builders
skills.trigger: a knowledge source or policy changes
minimum: sources, owners, access rules, and freshness needs

skills.name: hybrid-knowledge-retrieval-builder
skills.changes: governed knowledge into authorized hybrid retrieval
secondary_audience: application developers, knowledge owners, and evaluators
skills.trigger: task-time retrieval is required
minimum: knowledge contract, use cases, and authorization needs

skills.name: knowledge-profile-evaluator
skills.changes: task needs into a least-privilege knowledge profile
secondary_audience: orchestrators, security reviewers, and knowledge owners
skills.trigger: a task needs knowledge-source selection
minimum: task, knowledge inventory, and access policy

skills.name: delivery-capability-conductor
skills.changes: delivery state into the smallest justified capability handoff
secondary_audience: specialist agents, delivery owners, and reviewers
skills.trigger: a new task or lifecycle-state change occurs
minimum: case, outcome, evidence, and permission boundary

skills.name: delivery-rescue
skills.changes: blocked delivery into a diagnosis and recovery path
secondary_audience: developers, reviewers, and delivery owners
skills.trigger: a CI, test, environment, runtime, or contract failure occurs
minimum: failure evidence and expected behavior
outputs: diagnosis, recovery plan, and validation conditions

skills.name: context-mastery
skills.changes: scattered evidence into a bounded context pack
secondary_audience: coding agents, reviewers, and learners
skills.trigger: task context is unclear or too broad
minimum: task objective and bounded source access

skills.name: knowledge-integrity
skills.changes: conflicting or stale knowledge into scoped reviewable decisions
secondary_audience: architects, reviewers, and future maintainers
skills.trigger: a decision, assumption, architecture statement, or source changes
minimum: claims, scope, and source references

skills.name: risk-ahead
skills.changes: latent delivery exposure into explicit risk controls
secondary_audience: delivery owners, architects, and security reviewers
skills.trigger: a task approaches a commitment gate
minimum: bounded task, dependencies, and constraints

skills.name: delivery-artifact-builder
skills.changes: requirements and evidence into a shareable delivery artifact
secondary_audience: Jira owners, developers, testers, and release managers
skills.trigger: a ticket, PR, test, readiness, or release artifact is requested
minimum: case, target stage, and bounded evidence

skills.name: delivery-learning
skills.changes: delivery outcomes into scoped learning candidates
secondary_audience: team leads, future agents, and promotion reviewers
skills.trigger: a delivery outcome or incident completes
minimum: outcome, evidence, and scope references

skills.name: human-judgment-amplifier
skills.changes: an automation boundary into a focused human decision request
secondary_audience: accountable experts, mentors, and delivery owners
skills.trigger: an authority, ambiguity, or expertise boundary is reached
minimum: decision objective, evidence, and options

skills.name: management-translation
skills.changes: technical evidence into a management decision artifact
secondary_audience: engineering and business leaders
skills.trigger: management review or escalation is required
minimum: delivery evidence, audience, and decision need

skills.name: delivery-capability-strategy
skills.changes: capability and token evidence into adoption strategy
secondary_audience: engineering leaders and capability owners
skills.trigger: capability outcomes are ready for strategy review
minimum: outcomes, economics, and constraints

skills.name: capability-harness-engineer
skills.changes: metadata and runtime evidence into a safer native-first harness
secondary_audience: Skill maintainers and runtime adapter authors
skills.trigger: a capability is added, misrouted, overloaded, or replaced by native behavior
minimum: runtime evidence, metadata, and evaluation cases

skills.name: self-service-analytics-mvp-builder
skills.changes: a known analytics scenario into a governed runnable vertical slice
secondary_audience: product owners, analytics developers, and customer stakeholders
skills.trigger: a paid scenario or first use case is known

skills.name: feature-delivery-case
skills.changes: lifecycle evidence into a durable case and readiness state
secondary_audience: product owners, developers, reviewers, and release managers
